description: Fix 5 issues identified in semantic review: Lenis rAF leak, Three.js uncapped render loop, scroll-section clipping, footer positioning, and CSS/Framer Motion transform conflict.
steps: Fix SmoothScroll.tsx: Store rAF ID and cancelAnimationFrame before lenis.destroy() on unmount
Fix FloatingGeometry.tsx: Switch Canvas to frameloop='demand' and use invalidate() pattern for visibility-gated rendering
Fix ScrollSection.tsx: Remove overflow:hidden from the inner motion div to prevent content clipping
Fix App.tsx: Wrap Footer in ScrollSection with highest z-index to prevent occlusion under sticky stack
Fix Pricing.tsx: Move animate-float-slow to a separate nested wrapper that Framer Motion does not animate
Fix Contact.tsx: Move animate-float-slow to a separate nested wrapper that Framer Motion does not animate
acceptance_criteria: SmoothScroll properly cancels rAF before destroying Lenis
FloatingGeometry Canvas uses demand frameloop to save GPU when offscreen
ScrollSection does not clip overflowing content like radial-glow pseudo-elements
Footer is properly positioned in the stacking layout
animate-float-slow CSS class does not conflict with Framer Motion transforms
Build passes: bun run build succeeds with zero errors
verification: Run 'bun run build' and confirm zero errors in output
